description: The line plot illustrates the memory cost in gigabytes (GB) for different video understanding models as a function of the number of frames processed. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Frames," ranges from 0 to 1000 frames, with tick labels at intervals of 200 frames. The y-axis, labeled "Memory (GB)," ranges from 0 to 400 GB, with tick labels at intervals of 50 GB. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different model. The VideoLLaMB line, marked with a red color and a circle marker, shows a steep increase in memory cost, starting at around 10 GB for 0 frames and reaching approximately 400 GB for 1000 frames. The VideoLLaMB-R line, marked with a yellow color and a square marker, remains relatively flat, starting at around 10 GB and ending at about 50 GB. The PLLaVA line, marked with a green color and a triangle marker, shows a moderate increase, starting at around 10 GB and reaching about 100 GB. The LLaVA-NeXT line, marked with a blue color and a diamond marker, also shows a moderate increase, starting at around 10 GB and reaching about 150 GB. Lastly, the VideoLLAVA line, marked with a purple color and a cross marker, exhibits a steep increase similar to VideoLLaMB, starting at around 10 GB and reaching approximately 400 GB.
